findings.detail: The planned raw receipt is reserved before open, copied only after genuine successful fd/name queries, completed before the consumed veto and independently bound to directory/fixed-name/actual descriptor identity. The veto leaves saved custody HeldUnvalidated and creation acceptance absent. Expected FILE_VALIDATION is conditional on the precise consumed decision and raw receipt; genuine query failure and other infrastructure remain rejected. Callback prepared return is not treated as engine recording.

Distinct pointer-free raw receipt, consumed decision and corruptible provider projection freeze before external cleanup. The versioned exact-size envelope is written afterward, cannot acknowledge its own completed write, and requires normal exit0. Parent uses its own nofollow observer descriptor and independently checks the trusted raw receipt, current name and owned metadata before bounded empty-file read and fixed cleanup. It never synthesizes accepted creation or uses the child's integer as a parent capability. New target ABI must be reviewed; historical4760-byte size is not reused.

All five shared assertions and three composites run on every future execution without harness control macros. C1 alone owns exported post-open query fidelity and domain inconsistency. C2 alone owns the supplied pair and all AC_INCOMPLETE-to-AC_RETURNED/public payload/known-failure consequences. C3 alone requires the eligible native cleanup attempt and its successful disposition, while truthful record shape and unexpected-error refusal remain shared. No unchanged predecessor assertion may duplicate these affected expectations.

The C2 normal error follows unchanged core OPEN-domain/next/publication source and reaches no follow-up provider operation. The C3 omission keeps a known held descriptor until ordinary exit without probing, retrying, compensating close or acknowledging process cleanup.

One authored direct module at index0, canonical32-byte a ID, full-width process identity0x1234567887654321, range[0x1000,0x2000) and requestpc0x1010/lr0/fp0 make the future setup concrete. No generated/frame/repeat/read-only case replay is planned. Four candidates and three controls per mode, with eight assertions each, are future specifications only.

All24 reused source pins and34 anchor bounds match. Complete helper comparison to its pinned ordinary-file predecessor shows only plan-file, experiment-directory and scope-string changes. Nofollow ancestor/leaf handling, exclusive writes, failed-packet preservation, no-overwrite public result, inclusive line-byte anchors and closed file inventory remain. The helper imports no child execution mechanism and was not invoked by this reviewer.

Shared safety now binds requested/eligible, saved descriptor and HeldUnvalidated input and requires attempted/entered/returned agreement.
